# Thomas Kim
* [History](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Thomas_Kim?action=history)
* [Purge](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Thomas_Kim?action=purge)
* [Talk (0)](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Talk:Thomas_Kim?action=edit&redlink=1)
[ThomasKim](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/c7/ThomasKim.png/revision/latest?cb=20260129015039 "ThomasKim")

## Thomas Kim
### Tenure
2025 – Present

### Title
Vehicle Designer
**Thomas Yeong-hoon Kim** is a South Korean Mattel employee who has worked with Hot Wheels since 2025 as a casting designer. Prior to working at Mattel he worked at Nissan and General Motors as an automotive designer and held internship opportunities with Bertone and GAEI.
